name: Kluczbork County (Poland, official flag)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, red and white in the ratio 1:6:1, charged towards the hoist with the county arms of Kluczbork: a white shield with a red castle and a cross; the official flag of the county authorities.
history: Established by resolution No. XVI/102/2000 of the county council of 21 March 2000, designed by Michał Marciniak-Kożuchowski; the official (urzędowa) flag used by the county authorities, with the arms at the hoist.
